title: Project Finalization Checklist
project: Hardware-Aware Data-Driven Testing and Fault Localization for Quantum Programs
purpose: Evidence-linked checklist for completing the existing project accurately; not the final report and not authorization for new experiments.

major_claims_evidence.claim: Local statevector simulator and circuit API provide supported gates, measurement, and finite-shot execution.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: Describe supported behavior only; not a general physical device simulator.

major_claims_evidence.claim: Statistical comparison reports distribution distances and applies finite-shot tolerance.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: A detected difference does not identify cause by itself.

major_claims_evidence.claim: Rule-based diagnosis combines distribution, direct circuit mismatch, and relevant calibration evidence and supports ambiguous/insufficient outcomes.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: Trace-only deviation does not establish a program fault; controlled cases are not population accuracy estimates.

major_claims_evidence.claim: High-level diagnosis runs a supplied circuit ideally and optionally with HardwareModel; lower-level diagnosis compares expected/observed circuits and distributions.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: diagnose_circuit does not take a separate reference circuit; diagnose_execution supports explicit expected/observed comparison.

major_claims_evidence.claim: Controlled local cases exercise normal, program edit, synthetic hardware, localization, ambiguity, and insufficient-evidence paths.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: Scenarios are controlled local/synthetic evidence, not physical measurements or generalization estimates.

major_claims_evidence.claim: Adapters exist for Bugs4Q/QMutBench and optional IBM integration.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: Selected adapter counts are not benchmark accuracy; IBM report is offline fixture validation, not live hardware evidence.

major_claims_evidence.claim: QMutBench-derived binary experiment has saved data, predictions, thresholds, and model parameter files.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: Labels are original-versus-mutant record-type labels, highly imbalanced and not independent behavioral truth; binary model is not a hardware classifier or the observable adapter model.

major_claims_evidence.claim: Controlled three-class ML evaluation uses five production observable features and family grouping.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: Controlled simulator labels, 30 families, collisions, coarse folds, no significance test, and no physical device data.

major_claims_evidence.claim: No compatible deployable three-class observable ML artifact is available.
major_claims_evidence.qualification: NPZ artifacts are binary trace-feature models; adapter tests use mocks and do not establish real artifact inference. Expected JSON artifact is absent.
README records 280 passed, older snapshots record 89 and 96. These differ and were not rerun or combined during checklist preparation.

primary_baseline.estimator: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1, max_iter=2000); fixed and unsearched

protocol.outer_evaluation: 30-fold leave-one-family-out GroupKFold; each test fold contains 9 rows and 3 per class; outer test folds are mutually disjoint by family.
protocol.inner_tuning: Five-fold GroupKFold over 29 outer-training families; inner macro-F1 chooses candidate hyperparameters; fixed baseline is unsearched.
protocol.preprocessing: Scaling fit on inner/outer training data only.

limitations: Each family fold has only 3 examples per class.
Outer training sets overlap across folds.
No significance test or real-hardware evidence.

tuned_candidate.name: logistic_tuned_C
tuned_candidate.status: Descriptive candidate only; not consistently improved or validated as a winner.

caveats: Keep earlier 1,952-row and later 1,675-row protocols separate.
All 211 originals have zero features; 1,258 mutants also have zero features.
Labels map record type directly and do not independently validate behavior.

demonstrable_capabilities.demo: Execute a supported circuit locally and show measurement counts.
Compare distributions and explain finite-shot tolerance.
Localize a direct expected/observed operation mismatch.
Show relevant synthetic calibration evidence for a qubit/gate/edge.
Show ambiguity/insufficient evidence when evidence is mixed or incomplete.
If presenting ML integration, show feature extraction/mock routing/abstention only.
demonstrable_capabilities.required_disclosure: No compatible real artifact inference is available or verified.

claims_to_qualify_or_omit.rule: Omit real-device validation/performance/live execution claims. State IBM integration is optional and offline fixture-tested.
Do not claim the proposed first wave evaluated T1/T2; that arm is blocked/excluded. Generic model fields do not establish physical relaxation or a validated time unit.
Describe only as a proposal reviewed READY FOR OWNER APPROVAL with execution preflight BLOCKED/STOP; no reports generated. B1 same-shot skip capture and B2 safe execution controls remain unresolved.
Do not claim general/reliable three-class ML; fixed baseline macro-F1 0.543 and hardware recall 0.367, tuned-candidate hardware recall 0.422, family gains inconsistent.
Do not claim a compatible trained/deployable artifact is integrated; binary trace NPZ artifacts cannot serve the five-observable, three-class adapter.
Call it classification of supplied record-type-derived labels; disclose imbalance, zero feature rows, and low NORMAL precision.
Describe only implemented HardwareModel/simulator mechanisms; do not claim arbitrary physical noise, calibrated device performance, or established hardware causality.
Adapter integration counts are not accuracy, precision, recall, F1, mutation score, or guaranteed attribution without independent ground truth.

recommended_final_report_structure: Title and abstract: bounded contribution and explicit simulator-only/no real-hardware statement.
Problem/objectives: separate output anomaly, program localization, hardware evidence, and uncertainty.
System design: simulator, circuit, hardware model, statistics, localizers, diagnosis engine, optional ML adapter boundary.
Implementation/verification: tested paths, controlled demos, provenance of historical test snapshots, unavailable integrations.
Data/labels: QMutBench derived sample/record labels/imbalance/zero features; 270-report controlled dataset and family labels.
Evaluation protocols: separate binary QMutBench protocols (1,952 untuned versus 1,675 tuned) and nested family-grouped three-class comparison.
Results: per-class metrics/confusion matrices, macro-F1/balanced accuracy, fixed LR, tuned candidate, dummy baseline, rule-based cases separately.
Threats/limitations: labels, imbalance, zeros, collisions, family count, synthetic mechanisms, absent compatible ML artifact, absent live hardware, no significance analysis.
Conclusion/future work: only supported claims; independent labels, broader families, resolving first-wave blockers, real hardware as future work.
Reproducibility appendix: exact paths, manifests, predictions, artifact schemas, historical test snapshots, missing evidence.
recommended_presentation_structure: Motivation: output deviation is not its cause.
Architecture: simulator/statistics/program and hardware evidence/diagnosis and abstention.
Demonstration: direct program mismatch, synthetic calibration case, ambiguous/insufficient case; label as local.
Dataset distinction: QMutBench-derived binary versus controlled simulator three-class data.
Protocol: family-level holdout, nested tuning, training-only scaler, no random row split claim.
Results: fixed grouped baseline first; tuned candidate and dummy comparison; per-class recall; separate binary result with label caveat.
Limitations/missing evidence: no real device, no T1/T2 first-wave result, weak hardware recall, no compatible deployed ML model, first wave blocked/deferred.
Close: implemented capabilities, bounded evidence, and future work required for stronger claims.
missing_evidence_to_disclose: No live IBM/backend execution or real-device calibration/result evidence is verified.
No completed first-wave report set, same-shot realized RX skip counts, or first-wave validation results exist.
No T1/T2 first-wave experiment exists; arm is blocked/excluded and no physical time-unit calibration is established.
No compatible observable three-class JSON model artifact exists at src/quantum_simulator/models/observable_logistic_regression.json; do not fabricate or convert binary NPZ parameters.
No independent behavioral ground-truth audit for every original/mutant label is present.
No significance test/confidence interval or broad family-generalization guarantee is reported for the 270-row evaluation.
Adapter presence does not establish availability of full official Bugs4Q/QMutBench source datasets.
No fresh tests were run for this checklist; historical totals 280, 89, and 96 are distinct snapshots and must not be combined.
No full CSV-wide reanalysis or bitwise cross-environment reproducibility was performed during the prior audit.
